exposure: Type of early microbial association (simple or complex)
Luminal perfusion of jejunal loops with enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli K88 (ETEC)
Luminal perfusion of jejunal loops with ETEC fimbriae (F4)
Luminal perfusion of jejunal loops with Lactobacillus amylovorus (LAM)
Luminal perfusion of jejunal loops with saline
outcome: Jejunal glycomic pattern profile (lectin binding: PNA, UEA, MALii, ConA, SBA, WGA positive cells)
cohort: Twelve caesarean-derived pigs, previously associated with a simple or complex microbiota, were selected at 26 to 37 days of age.
finding: The porcine A0 blood group genotype and the luminal presence of ETEC strongly affected the jejunal mucosa glycomic pattern profile, whereas an early oral simple or complex microbial association had limited effects.
